title: A Chicago teacher's students talk about the Hill

tellings.quote: and then I met a teacher in Chicago and her kids were talking about the hill

plain: A teacher in Chicago is said to have heard her students talking about "the hill," a place that children in this story speak of as somewhere they share in their minds. The documentary maker Ky Dickens, who made a film about children she says can read minds, tells Michels she met this teacher, and treats it as one more group of children independently describing the same place.
